title: Phase 1: Foundation & Infrastructure
deliverables: Infrastructure Setup (Section 10): Deploying UAT servers, OS hardening, and Virtualization layer.
Security Core (Section 5): Implementing Active Directory/LDAP integration, WAF, and SSL/Encryption.
Base Architecture: Setting up the microservices chassis (Spring Boot/FastAPI) and Container orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker).
Database Layer: Installation of PostgreSQL (Transactional) and MinIO (Document Store).
testing: Infra Verification: Security penetration testing and load balancing checks.
notes: Team Focus: 2 Engineers on Infra/Sec, 3 Devs on Core Auth & Architecture. Includes Eid al-Fitr break (~Mar 20).

title: Phase 2: Core Data & Rules MVP
deliverables: CBS Integration: Building connectors for the Core Banking System (Conventional & Islamic).
Data Lake MVP: Initial setup of the schema-agnostic repository for structured transaction logs.
Real-time Pipeline: Kafka setup for streaming high-velocity channel data (ATM, POS).
Rule Engine Core: Deploying Drools/Kogito with top 10 critical fraud scenarios.
testing: Data Integrity: Verifying transaction flow and basic rule triggering.
notes: Accelerated phase combining data ingestion with immediate rule value. Includes Eid al-Adha (~May 27).

title: Phase 3: AI Profiling & Behavioral Intelligence
deliverables: Customer Profiling: AI models to build dynamic 'Normal Behavior' baselines.
Anomaly Detection: Unsupervised learning models to flag outliers.
Agentic AI Pilot: Autonomous agents for continuous risk scoring.
Link Analysis: Graph database setup for hidden connection visualization.
testing: Model Backtesting: Validating AI detection rates against historical data.
notes: Parallel execution: Engineers on MLOps, Devs on API integration.

title: Phase 4: Case Mgmt & Workflows
deliverables: Case Manager UI: Full investigation dashboard with history and notes.
BPMN Integration: Visualizing and executing investigation processes.
Regulatory Reporting: Automated STR/SAR generation modules.
Executive Dashboards: Real-time charts for management visibility.
testing: UAT Round 1: Analysts use the system in shadow mode.
notes: Focus on UX and investigator efficiency.

title: Phase 5: Hardening, UAT & Go-Live
deliverables: Performance Tuning: Optimizing DB queries and API latency.
Training: Hands-on sessions for Admins and Analysts.
Disaster Recovery Drill: Full simulation of primary site failure.
Production Go-Live: Final cutover and system launch.
testing: Final Acceptance: Sign-off from all stakeholders.
notes: Milestone: Full Enterprise Launch by Mid-August.
